decisions.reason: The ERP interface supports the firm's end-to-end and multichannel direction and client retention, so it likely still meets aspirations even though it has not appeared on the website since 2019.

Price comparison tracking still fits the paid advertising and analytics services, and upkeep is cheap, so growing slack lets the firm carry it as the remaining product in this group despite low visibility.

As an overlapping price comparison plugin with no visible presence since 2019, it falls short of aspirations, and consolidating it frees developer time for new projects such as the platform migration.
Its companion net price display plugin was already withdrawn and it has not been visible for two years, which signals a performance gap, so its resources are better moved to the core business.
